name: Griselbrand
description: Griselbrand is a demon lord who was one of Liliana's demonic masters and who trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him.

description_citations.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

summary.text: Griselbrand is a demon lord who was one of Liliana's demonic masters and who trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him.

status.text: Griselbrand was killed by Liliana, though the latest event shows Avacyn imprisoning her sisters in the Helvault with Edgar Markov and Griselbrand.

citations.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.
"The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill her demon patron Kothophed and then Griselbrand, and her earlier ill-fated visit to learn of the Onakke.
timeline.quote: Instead of bringing it back to him like a good little retriever, she'd used its power to kill him.

citation.text: "Veil of Deceit" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Dovid solves the Nightfall Cathars' spell on the journal and learns that Avacyn had been sealed with Griselbrand and that church power diminished, a secret kept from the congregation.
timeline.quote: Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand, and during that time our power had diminished.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Liliana recalls using the Chain Veil to kill Kothophed and Griselbrand and being unable to leave it behind.
timeline.quote: It was bound to her, and her to it.

citation.text: "Unkindness of Ravens" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jul 2015.

timeline.summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn imprisons her sisters in the Helvault with Edgar Markov and Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She imprisoned them in the Helvault with the foul Edgar Markov and sinister Griselbrand, where they might contemplate their folly.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn at the Helvault; she drives him in but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Disappearance of Balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, Griselbrand and numerous other demons are released from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: has been released from her prisoning, the Helvault .

citation.text: "Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana retrieves the Chain Veil from the Shandalar catacombs as instructed by Kothophed, then uses it to destroy Kothophed and Griselbrand and pass the demon curse to Garruk.
timeline.quote: retrieved the Chain Veil from the catacombs at Shandalar

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged Avacyn.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Disappearance of balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Avacyn's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bolas brokers Liliana's deal with four demons.
timeline.quote: Bolas then brokered a deal with the four demons who would give Liliana her youth and a fraction of her old power back, in exchange for servitude.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Early life". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana kills Griselbrand with the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: used the Chain Veil to kill Griselbrand once and for all before leaving Innistrad

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mikaeus witnesses the duel of Avacyn and Griselbrand and their imprisonment, swearing the witnesses to secrecy.
timeline.quote: those present (including the Lunarch himself) chose to swear themselves to secrecy

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "Imprisonment of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks Avacyn into banishing him into the Helvault and pulls her in, sealing them both.
timeline.quote: sealing them both inside

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus Cecani's corpse and learns Griselbrand is trapped in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: learning from him that Griselbrand was trapped in the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana uses the Chain Veil to obliterate Griselbrand permanently.
timeline.quote: Liliana used the Chain Veil to obliterate him permanently

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Consequences". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

citation.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
